title: YouthWorks Summer and Year-Round Jobs
sponsor: Massachusetts Executive Office of Labor and Workforce Development (run by Commonwealth Corporation)
pay_text: At least the state minimum wage; ages 14 to 15 get a similar stipend
who_text: Massachusetts young people ages 14 to 25; you apply through the YouthWorks program or MassHire Career Center for your city or town
description: YouthWorks is a state-funded program that places young people in paid, short-term jobs at public, private and nonprofit worksites. The summer session lasts 6 to 8 weeks, and there is also a school-year option. You also get job-readiness training, and deadlines are set by your local program.
